messages:
maria: kicking off SEA1 GPU cluster networking bring-up. primary items: TGW peering to transit, route propagation, NAT egress pools, DNS delegation for sea.redwood, and a quick cost check for NAT+bandwidth. handoff target: next oncall window friday 02:00-04:00 UTC.

kevin: +1. do we have the TGW attachment ids and the expected bgp ASNs?

maria: TGW-att-0a1b2c3d (our side) -> transit-tgw-9f8e7d6c. BGP: local ASN 64512, transit side 65010. i'll paste the terraform snippet in a sec.

raj: flag: need to reserve ephemeral eip pool for NAT. cloud quota in SEA is limited; last time we hit the 50 eip default. can we use elastic NAT gateway + small autoscaling of nat instances? cost wise nat-gw is ~ $0.045/hr + $0.045/GB in this region (rough estimate).

anna: for DNS, we should create a delegated zone sea.redwood-internal and add NS records to our parent in zone redwood-infra. ops needs to provision the hosted zone and then we'll add the glue. link to runbook: https://redwood.tools/runbooks/network/zone-delegation (see step 3).

kevin: terraform snippet for TGW attachment + route table propagation:
```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_attachment" "sea1_tgw_attach" {
  transit_gateway_id = var.transit_tgw_id
  vpc_id             = module.vpc.vpc_id
  subnet_ids         = module.vpc.private_subnets
}
resource "aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table_propagation" "prop" {
  transit_gateway_route_table_id = var.tgw_rt_id
  transit_gateway_attachment_id = aws_vpc_attachment.sea1_tgw_attach.id
}
```

maria: thanks. also need to add BGP community tagging so upstream can prefer local region in case of failover. planned community: 65010:110 (SEA-prefer).

taylor: test plan checklist (short):
- verify TGW attachment status (aws cli)
- bgp session ESTABLISHED (show ip bgp summary / cloud console)
- propagate routes to tgw rt and confirm with traceroute to 10.240.0.1 (vpc-cidr peer)
- egress test: curl http://ifconfig.me from private instance -> ensure source ip is NAT EIP
- dns delegation: dig @ns1.redwood-infra sea.redwood-internal. -> returns our NS
- iperf or qperf between gpu nodes and internal model-store endpoint

raj: small note: GPU bootstrap will gate on networking health. we'll only scale GPU nodes past node pool=3 once egress+bgp+dns pass. avoids flapping compute if zone has network misconfigurations.

maria: agreed. also cost estimate roughly: 2 x nat-gw active + 4 EIP (for lb) + transit data egress ~ 8TB/mo -> ~ $360 (nat gw) + $360 (egress @ $0.045/GB) + EIPs. i will run exact numbers in the spreadsheet.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-842 SEA1 TGW attach + DNS delegation (owner: kevin)

kevin: i've requested quota increase for EIPs and requested a transient allowance for 10 additional EIPs. pending approval from cloud-quotas.

anna: DNS question: who will request the parent zone NS changes? ops or sec? want to avoid waiting last minute.

maria: ops will handle parent NS updates. anna please add the exact NS records to the runbook, i'll review.

taylor: a couple troubleshooting hints to add to runbook:
- if BGP stuck in Idle, check security group for TGW attachments (SGs shouldn't block BGP ports) and ensure the customer gateway has correct ASN.
- on NAT failures, check source/destination check on instances (must be false) and route table entry for 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat.

raj: done with initial smoke terraform apply in staging (tag: sea1-ntwk-smoke). results: TGW attach OK, route propagation visible, bgp session established, but NAT eip allocation failed due to quota.

maria: action items then:
- kevin: follow up on quota ticket and get approval for 10 extra EIPs (target EOD)
- anna: add NS delegation steps + verify automation runbook (target EOD)
- raj: rerun smoke after quota unblocked and attach screenshot of bgp summary and route table
- taylor: prepare oncall playbook with rollback steps (how to detach TGW, blackhole routes, and scale down GPU nodes)

sre-oncall: one more ask: during handoff, please include expected failover coordinates (which regions will accept traffic if SEA degraded) and which model-variants are pinned to SEA to avoid failing over expensive variants.

maria: good call — i'll add pinned model list to the handoff doc and include traffic steering policy (prefer SEA, fallback US-EAST).

kevin: will post quota update here once cloud approves.

ops-bot: INFRA-842 status: QUOTA_REQUESTED -> QUOTA_APPROVED (10 EIPs)

raj: re-ran smoke tests after quota approval: NAT EIPs allocated, egress check passed, traceroute shows expected path through transit-tgw-9f8e7d6c. attaching logs in ticket.

maria: great. i'm scheduling the formal handoff doc and adding the final checklist to the runbook. target handoff window still friday 02:00-04:00 UTC. ops: please include cost tracker for first 30 days, mark any anomalies.

taylor: copying the minimal rollback commands into runbook now. example to withdraw TGW attachment:
```bash
aws ec2 delete-transit-gateway-vpc-attachment --transit-gateway-attachment-id tgw-attach-0a1b2c3d
aws ec2 replace-route-table-association --association-id rtbassoc-xxx --route-table-id rtb-rollback
```

maria: thanks all. if no blockers by EOD we'll proceed to schedule the Friday window. :thumbsup:

kevin: one last thing — cost sensitivity: if egress trending above 10TB/mo, recommend enabling compression/caching on model-store proxys to reduce cross-region traffic. will add to optimize ticket.

anna: noted. i'll prep DNS automation patch so the delegation step is one click during the window.

sre-oncall: ready for handoff once runbook includes pinned model list + failover coordinates. i'll run a mock failover in staging next week.

maria: closing thread for now, will reopen during handoff. thanks everyone. :pray:
